direction: Original cinematic realism, optical glass and restrained titanium, a neural spiral and planetary horizons; calm product storytelling with human purpose.

references.use: Quality references only; do not copy their logos, artwork, compositions or product claims.

graphicsRules: Every asset has a specific story or product role, source record, truthful caption where needed and responsive treatment.
No generic humanoid heads, robot faces, stock chatbot illustrations or unrelated decorative card grids as primary product identity.
Show the actual interface or a clearly labelled concept. Imagined artwork cannot establish a working product, model, customer outcome or regional coverage.
Artwork should blend into the page composition. Preserve deliberate negative space, readable typography, consistent light and materials, and a clear next action.

Favor open editorial sequences, full-bleed imagery and hairline dividers over decorative card grids, pills and framed text containers. Reserve contained surfaces for a real form field, control or essential status boundary.
Product diagrams explain interfaces; they do not substitute for finished product artwork or customer experience evidence.
No embedded marketing text, invented certification marks, customer logos, fake citations or fabricated telemetry in generated art.

delivery.upscaling: Disclose enhancement and original dimensions; never describe an enlarged export as native high-resolution capture.
delivery.pixelCoverage: Measure the rendered contain/cover box, native export dimensions and DPR. Report density shortfalls; do not upscale and claim native detail.

motion.reducedMotion: Static equivalent; no essential information depends on motion.
motion.voice: Microphone permission only after an explicit customer action; show actual engine/voice availability.
motion.film: Selected master, measured duration, rights, poster, captions where applicable, mobile budget and a reviewed final cut before publication.

performanceTargets.evidence: Field performance remains unmeasured until real traffic and approved instrumentation exist; local browser checks do not establish these targets.

visualAcceptance.rule: Every criterion must pass. Record human review of the exact website fingerprint, all route screenshots and selected asset rights. A test pass or generated image is not visual approval.
visualAcceptance.evidence: Existing owner decision artifact and hashed route-by-viewport screenshots; local files validate evidence identity and content, not the human actor. Independent exact-commit review remains separate.
